explanation: Variant of Green's Problem 75 with an unspecified constant (the Kupitz question as in Conlon–Lim, Section 1): ∃ C : ℕ such that every finite X ⊂ ℝ² with ≥ 2 points has distinct p, q ∈ X with imbalance X p q ≤ C. Uses the same imbalance definition as green_75 and is implied by it with C = 100, as the docstring notes. A reasonable and correctly stated weakening.
